propositions: The comment-hygiene gate runs in CI but is unreachable locally via make lint, only via the full pytest suite, causing a local-CI verdict mismatch.
A missed comment-hygiene finding in change 1999 triggered a full review cycle and CI failure because make lint returned clean while the dedicated CI step rejected the tree.

The standalone runtime of check_comment_hygiene.py is ~4.9s warm; adding it to make lint increases lint baseline from 17.8s to ~22.7s, an acceptable cost relative to the 15-minute CI penalty for misses.

The introducing ticket for the comment-hygiene gate shows no deliberate intent to exclude it from make lint and instead follows the scripts/check_*.py convention already established by gen_env_registry.py --check in the lint target.
